scientific_limitations: Unit-edge finite metric trees, real continuous edgewise W^{1,1}, unweighted arclength mean and unweighted Euclidean leaf vector only. Sharp norm is a supremum, never attained by nonconstant W^{1,1} data. General weighted graphs, cycles, and other endpoint norms are not covered. Priority cannot be guaranteed against unindexed historical equivalents.
title: Balanced double-stars maximize the mean-zero \(W^{1,1}\) leaf trace on unit metric trees
